messages: zoe (Design): quick sync on Settings form patterns — need to pick required-field treatment + validation for multi-step wizards + delete-team modal copy before handoff. harry (PM): thumbs. what are the options? alex (DevEx): a11y first: SR announcements for required state + live region for summaries. sam (Eng): impl prefers one visual pattern + SR helpers for consistency. zoe (Design): Option A = small asterisk on labels + legend at top for long forms. Option B = visible \"Required\" micro-label on some fields. zoe (Design): compact markup example: required + aria-required on input. harry (PM): for wizards, show a compact error summary at step top with anchors to fields; users miss inline errors when scrolled. alex (DevEx): yes — summary should be aria-live and keyboard-focus the first invalid field when clicked. also announce count. sam (Eng): we can add data-error-id attrs, single handler for focus. debounce validation so we don't re-render constantly. zoe (Design): delete-team copy: current \"Delete team\" is terse. Options: \"Permanently delete team\" vs \"Delete team and all data\". which to use? harry (PM): prefer explicit: \"Permanently delete team\" + typed confirm for org-level teams; undo toast for light deletes. alex (DevEx): typed confirm needs labelled input, clear instructions, button disabled until match, and mismatch announced via role=alert. sam (Eng): backend supports 14-day soft-delete for teams — update copy to reflect restore window if we want. ci-bot: PR created on branch feat/settings-validation-ux :rocket: zoe (Design): decision summary: asterisk + sr-only required for compact UIs, legend for long forms, step-level error summary with anchors for multi-step, and \"Permanently delete team\" modal with typed-confirm for org-level deletes + undo toast for light deletes. i'll update Figma and write acceptance criteria. harry (PM): i'll confirm retention wording with legal. alex (DevEx): i'll add keyboard/a11y checks to the ticket. sam (Eng): noted perf guardrails. thanks all :thumbsup:
